label: Tester unit
one_line: An open deck for testers, each with room to go back, and a row for their caps.
for: One tester per shade on the counter, taken out and put back all day.

locks.what: the header's two leaves, by barbed tongues through the back wall's rim
each inner leaf and stair foot through the floor, level with its underside
each stair's rear tabs through the back wall's inner leaf

allowances.panel_ends: half a caliper + fit gap short of the surface met
allowances.corner_folds: one caliper + fit gap, so a flap lies on the panel's inner face

codes: The tester fixtures found are moulded plastic (US9060625, US10470593); cap-and-tube openings from US4610348. A board tester deck: no source.
provisional: Tilt 5–10° from a plastic fixture patent; a board deck wears: a sample decides its coating.
A tester may lean 5° in its opening (2026-10-31): at a sealed product's 3° its deck stood so high that under half its colour window showed.
